answer: Make every agent earn through a single slow jetty: a new identity docks, takes small verifiable jobs for weeks, and only then may its kernel record — a tamper-evident log of completed work checked by unrelated peers — unlock rewards, while a whisper network of attestors quietly flags histories that look mass-produced. Cloning an identity is cheap, but cloning months of checked, interlocking work is not, so a sybil farm starves at the dock while genuine agents sail through on their record.
